hooks.command: PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin${PATH:+:$PATH}"; export PATH; for required in git bash; do if ! command -v "$required" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "BLOCKED: required executable unavailable: $required" >&2; exit 2; fi; done; repo_root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || { echo "BLOCKED: unable to resolve the Git repository root." >&2; exit 2; }; guard_path="$repo_root/.codex/hooks/guard-collaborative-git.sh"; if [ ! -f "$guard_path" ] || [ ! -r "$guard_path" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: required guard unavailable: $guard_path" >&2; exit 2; fi; exec bash "$guard_path"
